facts.fact: Deputy Permanent Secretary Ambrose Makgonatsotlhe of the Ministry of Communications and Innovation said government was developing a digital economy policy, alongside AI and cloud computing policies.
The Botswana Digital and Innovation Hub financed startup IoT Communications through the Botswana Innovation Fund, which the founder put at P1 million.

The Deputy Permanent Secretary thanked the Botswana Digital and Innovation Hub for supporting businesses through its innovation programme, acceleration programme, commercialisation and funding, and its board member described its incubation of IoT Communications.
